title: (Senior) Collection Merchandiser Shoes (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Aeyde
description_html:
What you will do:

As the (Senior) Collection Merchandiser for the Shoes category, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the strategic direction of the footwear assortment. 

This role requires a deep understanding of luxury fashion, strong collaboration skills, and the ability to drive innovation while maintaining the brand's identity. You will work closely with the design, product development, sales, marketing, and operations teams to create a cohesive and successful shoe collection that meets the needs of both direct-to-consumer (D2C) and business-to-business (B2B) channels.

Assortment Strategy:

  • Develop and implement a long-term assortment strategy for the Shoes category, aligning with the brands product vision and catering to the unique requirements of D2C and B2B channels.
  • Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and consumer insights to inform strategic decision-making.
Collection Creation:
  • Lead the seasonal collection creation process for Shoes, working in close partnership with the design and product development teams.
  • Ensure the collection reflects the brand's DNA, resonates with target customers, and meets commercial objectives.
  • Own the range and the line plan and ensure they are constantly updated.
Critical Path Management:
  • Own the critical path for the Shoes category, ensuring all key milestones and deadlines are met.
  • Schedule and coordinate all relevant meetings, ensuring appropriate stakeholders are involved and prepared.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
  • Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to develop compelling campaigns and product stories that enhance the visibility and desirability of the Shoes category.
  • Work with sales teams to gather feedback from wholesale partners and clients, ensuring their needs are reflected in the assortment.
  • Foster strong communication and collaboration across departments to achieve common goals.
  • Partner with operations to ensure smooth product delivery and availability across all channels.
Performance Analysis:
  • Monitor and analyze the performance of the Shoes category, identifying opportunities for growth and areas for improvement.


What you will bring:

  • Proven experience (4-5 years) in a merchandising or product management role within the luxury fashion industry, ideally with a focus on footwear.
  • Strong understanding of the luxury market, including D2C and B2B dynamics.
  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and meet tight deadlines.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
  • Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to build strong relationships across departments.
  • Passion for luxury fashion, design, and craftsmanship.


What we offer:

  • A bright and spacious design office in the heart of Berlin embodying our brand values and focusing on employee well-being.
  • A unique chance to shape our company’s future and build a global brand, all within a motivating, international work environment with employees of 14+ nationalities.
  • A high level of responsibility, creative freedom, and the opportunity to bring your originality, ideas, and independence to life.
  • Once-per-season gift voucher, to be used on Aeyde footwear and accessories.
  • Subsidized Urban Sports Club membership, Berlin Public Transport pass or German lessons for international employees.
  • 30 days of holidays.
  • Flexible hybrid working model subject to team specifications.
  • Regular team events include our Christmas and Summer Party as well as extraordinary monthly team lunches.
  • Relocation assistance available including visa support.

Dafür entwickeln wir eine eigene KI-Plattform mit spezialisierten KI-Agenten und Skills, die unsere Teams im Kanzleialltag konkret unterstützen – etwa bei der Aufbereitung von Daten, der Qualitätssicherung, der Recherche und der Erstellung strukturierter Arbeitsergebnisse.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Sie übersetzen Anforderungen aus der Steuerberatung, Wirtschaftsprüfung und Unternehmensberatung in klare und robuste KI-Workflows. 
  • Sie formulieren und optimieren Prompts, Entscheidungslogiken und strukturierte Fragebögen. 
  • Sie testen Ergebnisse systematisch, erkennen Fehlerbilder und entwickeln unsere Qualitätsstandards weiter. 
  • Sie unterstützen bei der Anbindung und Nutzung von Datenquellen und Tools, beispielsweise DATEV-Exporte, Tabellen, Dokumente oder interne Wissensbestände. 
  • Sie dokumentieren Lösungen verständlich und sorgen dafür, dass Kolleginnen und Kollegen diese sicher anwenden können. 
  • Sie verfolgen neue Entwicklungen rund um KI-Agenten, Large Language Models und Automatisierung und bringen geeignete Ideen pragmatisch in die Umsetzung. 
Für die Entwicklung und Umsetzung Ihrer Ideen erhalten Sie Zugriff auf gängige KI- und Coding-Tools wie Claude und Codex.


Ihr Profil

  • Sie studieren Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaftslehre (mit Digital- oder Technologieschwerpunkt) oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang.

  • Idealerweise bringen Sie erste praktische Erfahrungen mit Python, APIs, Datenaufbereitung, Automatisierung oder Vibe Coding mit. 
  • Sie arbeiten strukturiert, denken analytisch und geben sich nicht mit einer Antwort zufrieden, nur weil diese überzeugend klingt. 
  • Sie können komplexe Themen verständlich erklären und arbeiten gerne mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen zusammen. 
  • Vorkenntnisse in der Steuerberatung, im Rechnungswesen oder im Umgang mit DATEV sind willkommen, aber kein Muss – Ihr Interesse und Ihre Lernbereitschaft zählen. 
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden Ihr Profil ab. 


Warum wir?

  • Flexibel bleiben: Arbeitszeiten, die zu Studium, Alltag und Leben passen.

  • Sicher starten: HWS gibt es seit 1923 – und trotzdem schauen wir nach vorn. 
  • Modern & zukunftsorientiert: Digitale Prozesse und gezielter Einsatz von KI für mehr Raum für wirklich wichtige Aufgaben. 
  • International vernetzt, fachlich stark: Internationales Partner- und Expertennetzwerk für vielfältige fachliche Perspektiven.
  • Einfach ausgezeichnet: HWS ist als Arbeitgeber mehrfach ausgezeichnet – unter anderem mit dem TOP JOB Award 2026. 
  • Mehr für Sie: Moderne Arbeitsplätze, Rabatte für Mitarbeitende und Angebote rund um Gesundheit und Wohlbefinden. 
  • Echt im Team: Menschen, die zusammenhalten, sich unterstützen und den HWS-Spirit leben.

description_html:
About Agicap

Created in Lyon in 2016 by three French entrepreneurs, Agicap is one of the fastest scale-ups in Europe, with over 8000 customers, 650 employees and fast revenue growth (7x between 2021 and 2024). Agicap is part of the French Tech 120, rewarding the most promising startups in France.

Agicap allows Finance teams of Mid-Market companies to efficiently manage and forecast their cash, pay their suppliers and get paid. By combining a Treasury Management System, and Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable solutions into a single platform, Agicap aims at becoming the next leading Treasury Management platform for mid-market companies.

We have raised €145M since our creation, with prestigious VC funds including AVP, Greenoaks, Partech and BlackFin, with a last round in November 2024.

These additional resources further fuel our product innovation, allowing us to grow significantly and accelerate our international expansion across the world.

We believe our success comes from our highly passionate and dedicated teams, committed to building a company where people can grow and build their careers. We are constantly looking for great talents, aiming for excellence and ready to join our ambitious adventure!

Home page
Customer Stories
Our Values

About the Account Executive - Mid-Market role:
 
In daily collaboration with the Business Development team, Outbound SDR, Inbound SDR, and Partnership Managers, your mission will be to generate new business by acquiring new logos.
 
As a Mid Market Account Executive at Agicap, you will be responsible for driving sales and expanding our customer base within the mid-market segment. You will play a crucial role in identifying new business opportunities, building relationships with potential clients, and closing deals to achieve your sales targets.

You will be responsible for:

  • Sharing your commercial expertise and good ideas to enhance the team’s performance.

title: Senior Product Engineer - iOS/Swift
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Qonto
description_html:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,600+ Qontoers serving over 600,000+ customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Location: You can apply to work at Qonto as long as you're living in (or willing to relocate to) either Germany, France, Italy, Serbia, Portugal, or Spain.
 
Mission
 
Join us as an iOS Engineer and help us build the most intuitive mobile banking experience for European businesses. You'll be crafting features that directly impact the daily financial operations of over 600,000 SMEs across Europe, making their business finance simpler and more efficient.
 
As an iOS Engineer at Qonto, you will:
 
• Craft cutting-edge financial features: Work on critical architectural and UI features that will directly impact our end users.
• Foster meaningful collaboration: Work closely with back-end teams, designers, and product managers to create a unified vision.
• Solve real-time challenges: Tackle real-time synchronization issues and spearhead new initiatives.
• Champion quality: Maintain an exceptional level of quality by implementing continuous refactoring and unit testing to consistently enhance the codebase.
 
What you can expect
 
• You'll be building for Europe's fastest-growing business banking market, with 600K+ clients across multiple countries and ambitious expansion plans
• Work in an environment that prioritizes quality, comprehensive code reviews, component approach and continuous refactoring as standard practice
• Contribute to a fully Swift-based app using MVP and Coordinators architecture, with modern CI/CD through GitHub, Firebase, and Bitrise
• Access to expert mentorship, Tech Weeklies & Monthlies, and conference opportunities to stay at the forefront of iOS development
 
Our methodology, the Qonto Way
We value upfront technical design, team reviews, and smart slicing, quality drives the velocity our customers need;
Our org assigns one team lead per project across stacks, giving your team a clear mission and full autonomy on how it operates;
Our lean toolbox, Kaizen, PDCA, lets you monitor and drive continuous improvement collaboratively with your peers and manager;
Each engineer gets access to Cursor or Copilot, and we want people who use AI to raise the bar, not just to go faster.
 
Your future team

As an iOS Engineer, you will join one of Qonto's squad teams, each organized around a clear project mission, with one team lead and full ownership of a product scope. You'll be part of a 140 mobile engineering community within a 500 Product Engineering department, working in focused teams of 5 to 10 people alongside Product, Design, and peers from Frontend and Backend.
 
Our stack & practices

Our app is 100% Swift, built on MVP & Clean Architecture with 35+ independent modules. We use the Coordinator pattern for scalability, and all new screens are built in SwiftUI (MVVM) with async/await — 80+ screens already migrated. Project generation and build optimization run on Tuist. CI/CD covers GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Firebase Test Lab, Sonar, and Fastlane.

We take technical excellence seriously: 30,000+ unit tests, 450+ snapshot tests, SwiftyMocky for mock generation, and LLMs integrated into our dev workflow. Our modular architecture (32 reusable modules + centralized design system) ensures fast builds, clear ownership, and safe iterations.

Want to know more about our mobile performance indicators? Read this.


About You
 
• iOS Expertise: Proven experience as a Mobile engineer with strong Swift skills and deep understanding of the iOS ecosystem, SDK, and development lifecycle
• Quality-driven development: Strong commitment to best practices, including unit testing (XCTests, FBSnapshots), Clean code / SOLID principles, and organized workflows
• Problem-solving approach: Pragmatic and solution-oriented approach to engineering challenges, with ability to deliver tangible value in a fast-paced environment
• Collaborative spirit: Excellent communication skills, fluent english and experience working effectively in cross-functional teams with both technical and non-technical colleagues
• Growth mindset: Curious and proactive developer who thrives on learning new technologies and contributing to a product serving hundreds of thousands of users
At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.
 
By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.
 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here
 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

🔒 Your security matters to us

Recruitment scams are on the rise. Keep in mind, we will never work with third-party platforms or agencies that request payment from candidates.

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Business Intelligence, Finanzplanung und Konzernkonsolidierung

  • Praxis in der Analyse und Optimierung von Finance- und Controlling Prozessen
  • Kommunikationsstärke sowie souveränes Auftreten im Austausch mit Kunden und Fachbereichen
  • Analytische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise mit hoher Eigenverantwortung
  • Interesse an datengetriebenen Lösungen sowie Verständnis für BI- und Planungssysteme
  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse für die optimale Kundenberatung und Kommunikation im Team
  • Gelegentliche Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine und Workshops (ca. 1x im Monat)

Nice to Have:

  • Erfahrung mit IBM Planning Analytics TM1

Benefits

  • Je nach Qualifikation und Erfahrung erwartet dich ein attraktives Gesamtpaket
  • Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum: Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit direktem Einfluss auf Kundenprojekte und Unternehmensentwicklung
  • Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung: Freie Zeiteinteilung orientiert am Kundenbedarf sowie 2-3 Tage Home Office
  • Remote Möglichkeit: Auch deutschlandweite Remote Zusammenarbeit möglich, abhängig von Wohnort und Reisetätigkeit
  • Langfristige Entwicklungsperspektive: Möglichkeit zur fachlichen Weiterentwicklung bis hin zur Teamführung oder strategischen Rolle im Unternehmen
  • Spannende Kundenprojekte: Zusammenarbeit mit namhaften Unternehmen aus unterschiedlichen Branchen im Bereich BI, Planung und Konsolidierung
  • Mentoring und Wissenstransfer: Enger Austausch im kleinen Team mit direkter Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Spezialisten
  • Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Grünes Büro mit Terrasse, Küche und angenehmer Arbeitsatmosphäre
  • Mobilitätsangebote: Firmenparkplatz, Bike Leasing sowie je nach Rolle Firmenwagen möglich
  • Starkes Teamgefühl: Kleine Teams, kurze Entscheidungswege und regelmäßige gemeinsame Aktivitäten

Du möchtest Unternehmen nicht nur beraten, sondern aktiv dabei unterstützen, moderne Finanz- und BI-Lösungen aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln?
Dann bewirb dich jetzt als Senior Consultant BI & Konsolidierung!

title: Performance Marketing Manager (m/f/x)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at altitude
description_html:
Du willst nicht nur Kampagnen optimieren, sondern Wachstumsstrategien entwickeln, Budgets verantworten und Kunden als echter Sparringspartner begleiten? Dann bist du bei altitude richtig.

Als digitaler Growth Partner unterstützen wir Unternehmen dabei, Wachstum messbar, effizient und nachhaltig voranzutreiben. In deiner Rolle verbindest du strategisches Denken mit operativer Exzellenz und arbeitest eng mit unseren Teams aus Performance, Creative, Tech und Strategie zusammen.

Aufgaben

Performance-Strategie & Wachstum

  • Gemeinsam mit dem Projektteam entwickelst du passende Wachstums- und Performance-Marketing-Strategien für unsere Kunden.
  • Du übersetzt Geschäftsziele in konkrete Kanal-, Kampagnen- und Budgetstrategien über relevante Online-Marketing-Kanäle hinweg, darunter Paid Search, Paid Social, Display, Native und Programmatic.
  • Du steuerst Budgets kanal- und zielgruppenübergreifend und sorgst dafür, dass Maßnahmen effizient auf die definierten Wachstumsziele einzahlen.
  • Du analysierst laufend Performance-Daten, leitest konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab und passt Strategien regelmäßig an.
  • Du nutzt moderne AI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude und weitere Anwendungen, um Analysen, Recherchen, Kampagnenkonzepte, Reportings und operative Prozesse effizienter und wirkungsvoller zu gestalten.

Kampagnensteuerung & Marketing Operations

  • Du verantwortest das Setup, Management und die kontinuierliche Optimierung von Performance-Marketing-Kampagnen.
  • Du etablierst Reporting- und Controlling-Prozesse, überwachst relevante KPIs und behältst Budgets, Timings und Ergebnisse im Blick.
  • Du übersetzt Kundenziele in klare Aufgaben für das Performance-Team und gibst strukturierte Briefings.

KFZ-Mechatroniker für Luftfahrtbodengeräte (m/w/d)

  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Bereitstellung hochwertiger und funktionaler Arbeitskleidung
  • individuelle Weiterbildungen nach Qualifikationsbedarf

title: Analyst | Accounting, Global Billing (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Solactive AG
description_html:
Company Description

Since its creation in 2007 in the financial city of Frankfurt am Main, Solactive AG has grown to one of the key players in the indexing space. The German multi-asset index provider focusses on tailor-made indices, offering to its clients a faster service, with greater flexibility and at a reasonable cost. Solactive AG and its subsidiaries have become one of the fastest growing index providers over the past few years and support the leading investment banks and asset managers across the globe. We have gained global recognition for our role in the Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) industry, where we rank among the top providers worldwide for underlying indices. We also excel in diverse areas such as Structured Products and investment mandates, showcasing the wide range of our capabilities. The impact and value we bring to the market is palpable, but also in the reputation we have proudly built by being close to our customers, solidifying Solactive AG as a trusted and reliable ally in the ever-evolving global financial landscape.

Job Overview

Are you ready to become an integral part in building and scaling global billing operations of a fast-growing FinTech? Do you have a strong service and problem-solving mindset, attention to detail and a passion for numbers? Are you willing to take responsibility, ownership, and action to ensure a smooth and accurate billing process? Then you will very likely fit into our team!

Your Tasks

  • Manage the end-to-end billing process, including the accurate and timely preparation and issuance of customer invoices.
  • Process and validate Assets under Management (AuM) reporting data and maintain billing templates for AuM-based client accounts.
  • Perform billing quality checks to ensure invoice accuracy, completeness, and compliance with commercial agreements.
  • Act as the primary contact for invoice-related client inquiries and resolve billing discrepancies efficiently.
  • Maintain billing-related data in Salesforce and collaborate with Sales, Product, Legal, and Accounting teams on billing topics.
  • Identify opportunities to improve, standardize, and scale billing processes while taking ownership of issues through resolution.

Your Profile

  • 1-3 years of experience in billing, finance operations, accounting, or a comparable operational finance role.
  • Strong attention to detail, high accuracy, and a structured, reliable approach to managing deadlines and recurring tasks.
  • Advanced Excel skills and confidence working with financial data, business systems, and Salesforce or similar CRM platforms.
  • Strong problem-solving mindset, ownership mentality, and ability to independently drive issues to resolution.
  • Effective communication skills with experience collaborating across teams and interacting with clients.
  • Experience with AuM-based, usage-based, or other variable billing models, ideally in an international or cross-border business environment, with an interest in process improvement and automation.

Our Offer

  • Global Team: Join our motivated international team at Solactive
  • FinTech Excellence: Experience FinTech excellence at Solactive
  • Modern Culture: Enjoy our modern, flat hierarchy and startup-like culture
  • Responsibility & Connections: Take over responsibility from day one and build relationships in- and outside of the company.
  • Vacation: Enjoy 30 annual vacation days, plus extra time off for Christmas Eve and New Year
  • Competitive Compensation: Receive a competitive compensation package
  • Special Benefits: Job ticket and gym access, access to Corporate Benefits, modern office space with ergonomic set-up, employee lounge, and free beverages and fruits
  • Community & Networking: Engage in our various networking events
  • Professional Development: Grow both personally and professionally through our diverse training offers
  • Flexibility: Embrace a flexible work culture with the freedom to choose your work hours, including a hybrid work model, all within a diverse and dynamic environment

title: Principal Counsel, Africa Legal
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Zipline
description_html:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world's largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world's largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products. 

Our customers include the world's largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we've built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people's lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About You and The Role

Zipline is seeking a senior, strategic, and highly adaptable lawyer to lead and scale legal and compliance across multiple countries of operation in Africa. This role sits at the intersection of compliance execution and regulatory strategy and is critical to enabling Zipline's continued growth in complex and evolving regulatory environments.

You will independently lead all Africa Legal & Compliance operations and strategy while serving as an integral member of Zipline International's high-impact Legal Team. You will also be a key member of the Zipline Africa Leadership Team, with the Heads of People and Finance and our Country Directors, and with a dotted reporting line to Zipline Africa's CEO. You will work cross-functionally with the Africa Leadership Team, Operations, Policy, Government Affairs, People, Finance, and Engineering, and will report directly to Zipline's Deputy General Counsel.

This is a hands-on leadership role that offers the rare opportunity to build and shape the Legal function with significant autonomy, while benefiting from the collaboration and support of a larger global legal team. One day you may be advising on a complex Nigerian employment or a healthcare regulatory issue in Cote d'Ivoire; the next, developing compliance training for teams across Africa or helping the business navigate export controls, sanctions, anti-corruption, and other cross-border legal risks.

What You'll Do

  • Design, implement, scale, and continuously improve Zipline's legal and compliance programs across Africa, with a focus on sustainable, practical operations that support rapid growth
  • Lead day-to-day compliance workstreams covering sanctions, anti-bribery and anti-corruption, privacy, healthcare, employment, and product-related regulations
  • Support internal investigations, audits, and risk assessments, partnering closely with People, Finance, and senior leadership
  • Manage litigation and disputes across Zipline's African markets 
  • Translate complex regulatory requirements into clear, actionable guidance for business and technical teams
  • Own compliance with U.S. government award requirements, including FARs and 2 CFR 200, and serve as a primary point of contact for U.S. government contracting officers (including at the U.S. Department of State)
  • Monitor and assess regulatory and policy developments across relevant African jurisdictions and advise leadership on emerging risks and opportunities

Cross-Functional Partnership & Culture

  • Act as a senior legal advisor to business leaders, providing pragmatic, risk-calibrated guidance 
  • Build strong relationships across the company and help foster a durable "culture of compliance" where teams understand the rules of the road and feel empowered to raise issues early
  • Help shape Zipline's long-term legal and regulatory strategy in Africa, balancing compliance rigor with innovation and speed

What You'll Bring

  • A willingness to dive deep into unfamiliar issues and operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-environments
  • Strong judgment and the confidence to make independent decisions, coupled with the discernment to escalate when appropriate
  • Experience advising on legal and compliance matters, preferably in international or emerging-market environments
  • The ability to break down complex legal and regulatory problems into clear priorities and practical solutions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to advise senior stakeholders
  • A collaborative, solutions-oriented mindset and strong organizational skills
  • Willingness to travel up to ~25% to Africa and San Francisco headquarters

What Else You Need To Know

Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws or our own sensibilities.

We value diversity at Zipline and welcome applications from those who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this position but are not sure if you are the perfect fit, please apply!

Voluntary Self-Identification

For government reporting purposes, we ask candidates to respond to the below self-identification survey. Completion of the form is entirely voluntary. Whatever your decision, it will not be considered in the hiring process or thereafter. Any information that you do provide will be recorded and maintained in a confidential file.

As set forth in Zipline 's Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

description_html:
At pathway Solutions GmbH, we're on a mission to automate accounting for E-Commerce and SaaS companies. Our goal is to free 10,000 entrepreneurs from the burden of manual bookkeeping so they can focus on what they do best: growing their business.
We are a fast-paced, fully remote company experiencing significant customer growth, and we're looking for passionate builders to join us.

The Opportunity: own the domain of infrastructure

We are looking for a highly motivated Senior Java Developer to join our team at Pathway. You will be responsible for the development and maintenance of our core application, specifically focusing on our billing and invoice generation systems. We need someone who is not only a strong coder but also proactive, eager to master new technologies, and capable of solving complex infrastructure and concurrency challenges.

Tasks

  • Application Development: Design, develop, and maintain robust billing applications and features (e.g., invoice generation systems) using Java 25.
  • Concurrency & Performance: Architect and manage highly concurrent, multi-threaded application logic to ensure memory efficiency and system stability.
  • Infrastructure & DevOps: Take ownership of infrastructure tasks, ensuring our systems are scalable, reliable, and well-maintained.
  • Database Management: Utilize and optimize both SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g., Bigtable) to handle our evolving data requirements.
  • Integrations: Design and maintain high-quality API integrations, utilizing modern standards like Swagger/OpenAPI.
  • Cloud Operations: Implement and manage solutions within cloud environments (GCP preferred)

Requirements

title: Head of Customer Support (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at HotelNetSolutions GmbH
description_html:
Für Menschen, die Service nicht verwalten, sondern prägen.

Support wird oft unterschätzt.

Dabei entscheidet genau dieser Moment darüber, wie sich eine Zusammenarbeit anfühlt. Wenn etwas nicht funktioniert. Wenn eine Frage auftaucht. Wenn ein Hotel einfach jemanden braucht, der zuhört, versteht und eine Lösung findet.

Genau dort beginnt unsere Arbeit.

Wir sind HotelNetSolutions aus Berlin. Seit 2006 entwickeln wir Software für die Hotellerie. Keine Software von der Stange, sondern Lösungen, die sich den Hotels anpassen und nicht umgekehrt. Mit OnePageBooking, VoucherBooking, RateDistributor und der MultiPropertyView unterstützen wir heute mehr als 2.200 Hotels und Hotelgruppen dabei, mehr Direktbuchungen zu erzielen und ihre Persönlichkeit auch im Internet erlebbar zu machen.

Wir glauben nicht an anonyme Tickets. Wir glauben an Beziehungen. An Erreichbarkeit. An das gesprochene Wort. Und daran, dass guter Support weit mehr ist als die Antwort auf eine Frage.

Deshalb suchen wir niemanden, der Support nur verwaltet.

Wir suchen eine Führungspersönlichkeit, die Menschen entwickelt, Prozesse hinterfragt und gemeinsam mit seinem Team dafür sorgt, dass aus jedem Kontakt ein gutes Gefühl entsteht.

Aufgaben

  • Du führst unser internationales Customer Support Team mit Klarheit, Vertrauen und einem offenen Ohr. Du schaffst ein Umfeld, in dem Menschen gerne Verantwortung übernehmen und ihr Wissen miteinander teilen.
  • Du erkennst, wo Prozesse haken, bevor sie zum Problem werden. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team entwickelst du unseren Support kontinuierlich weiter und sorgst dafür, dass Qualität kein Zufall ist.
  • Du behältst Kennzahlen im Blick, ohne dabei den Menschen dahinter zu vergessen. Denn jede Zahl erzählt eine Geschichte. Man muss nur genau hinsehen.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Produktmanagement, Entwicklung und Vertrieb zusammen. Kundenfeedback landet bei dir nicht in einer Schublade, sondern dort, wo Produkte besser werden.
  • Auch wenn es einmal kompliziert wird, bleibst du ruhig. Du begleitest Eskalationen mit Souveränität und findest Lösungen, die langfristig tragen.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast bereits ein Customer Support oder Customer Success Team geführt und weißt, dass gute Führung nicht bedeutet, auf jede Frage selbst die Antwort zu kennen.
  • Du hast Freude daran, Menschen wachsen zu sehen und ihnen den Rücken freizuhalten.
  • Idealerweise hast du Erfahrungen aus Softwareunternehmen, das erklärungsbedürftige Produkte betreut. Du verstehst, wie wichtig verlässlicher Support für den Alltag unserer Kunden ist.
  • Besonders freuen wir uns über Erfahrung aus der Hotellerie. Ob Reservierung, Front Office oder Revenue Management: Wenn du den Hotelalltag kennst und die Sprache unserer Kunden sprichst, passt das hervorragend zu uns.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, denkst analytisch und triffst Entscheidungen mit Ruhe und Augenmaß.
  • Du kommunizierst klar, wertschätzend und verbindlich. Auf Deutsch mindestens auf C2 Niveau. Englisch hilft dir im internationalen Austausch.
  • Vor allem aber hast du Lust, Dinge besser zu machen. Nicht weil es im Prozesshandbuch steht, sondern weil du weißt, dass guter Service den Unterschied macht.

Benefits

Ein guter Support entsteht nicht durch Prozesse allein.

Er entsteht durch Menschen, die sich gegenseitig vertrauen. Die gerne zusammenarbeiten. Die auch an stressigen Tagen miteinander lachen. Genau so arbeiten wir.

Dich erwartet ein Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt, Wissen teilt und gemeinsam Lösungen findet. Ehrlich gesagt finden wir sogar, dass es das beste Team aller Zeiten ist. Wahrscheinlich sagen das viele. Wir meinen es wirklich.

Wir suchen Menschen, die bleiben möchten. Deshalb erhältst du einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag und eine langfristige Perspektive in einem inhabergeführten Unternehmen, in dem Zuverlässigkeit nicht nur auf der Website steht, sondern gelebt wird.

Treue soll sich lohnen. Deshalb wächst mit der Zeit auch dein Urlaubsanspruch.

Nach Feierabend ist Feierabend. Unsere Arbeitszeiten sind montags bis freitags geregelt. Überstunden kannst du in Freizeit umwandeln. Das Wochenende gehört dir.

Zwei Tage Home Office. Drei Tage gemeinsam im Büro. Für uns die richtige Mischung aus konzentriertem Arbeiten und persönlichem Austausch.

Unser Berliner Loft im Tiergarten hat den Charme eines echten Hinterhofs. Keine Hochglanzbüros. Dafür kurze Wege, offene Türen und Menschen, die man gerne trifft.

Dresscode? Komm so, wie du dich wohlfühlst. Hoodie funktioniert bei uns genauso gut wie Hemd.

Mitreden gehört bei uns dazu. Bei großen Entscheidungen genauso wie bei der Frage, welche Süßigkeiten als Nächstes im Büro landen.

Und weil Zusammenarbeit mehr ist als Meetings, verbringen wir auch außerhalb des Arbeitsalltags gerne Zeit miteinander. Mal auf der Spree. Mal beim Bowling. Und manchmal einfach bei unserer inzwischen legendären Kuchenparty.

Du bist startklar und willst endlich loslegen? Dann nichts wie los – wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Schick deinen CV direkt an Gabi, unsere HR & Executive Management Assistant , per Mail an

Wir können es kaum erwarten, dich bei uns willkommen zu heißen! 🚀

Aufgaben

  • End-to-End Ownership: Du bist nicht nur für Code verantwortlich, sondern für das Ergebnis. Du begleitest Features von der ersten Idee über die Architektur bis hin zum Live-Gang.
  • Vibe-Coding & AI-Leverage: Du nutzt moderne KI-Tools (Cursor, Copilot, CodeRabbit) als deine Sparringspartner, um rasend schnell Prototypen und produktionsreifen Code zu generieren.
  • Think out of the Box: Du nimmst Vorgaben nicht einfach hin, sondern hinterfragst technische Konzepte und Architektur-Entscheidungen im Sinne des besten Nutzererlebnisses.

Qualifikation

  • Product Sense: Du hast ein tiefes Verständnis dafür, was ein gutes Produkt ausmacht, und hast den Drang, Dinge schnell "live" zu bringen (Pragmatismus > Perfektionismus).

Benefits

description_html:
Du bist erfahrener Fachplaner (m/w/d) im Bereich Aufzugstechnik und auf der Suche nach einer neuen Herausforderung in Berlin, Hamburg, München oder Remote?

Vielleicht ist diese Position bei Buro Happold genau das, was Du suchst!

Aufgaben

  • Umsetzung der planerischen Aufgaben für zugewiesene Projekte im definierten Planungsumfang sowie Verantwortlichkeiten als Projektleiter der Disziplin Fördertechnik/Vertical Transportation für alle Leistungsphasen einer Gebäudeplanung (z.B. HOAI, RIBA, AIA)

  • Erarbeitung von technischen Spezifikationen für nicht-standardisierte Anlagen sowie Planung von Sonderanlagen
  • Projektkommunikation und -dokumentation auf Deutsch und Englisch
  • Technische Schnittstelle zu anderen Gewerken, Architekturbüros, Projektentwicklerinnen/ -entwicklern und herstellenden Unternehmen
  • Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von internen Standards und Tools zur Optimierung des Planungsprozesses
  • Qualitätsprüfung und -sicherung der Arbeit des gesamten Teams
  • Unterstützung der Tätigkeiten des Vorgesetzten wie z.B. Projektplanung, Angebotserstellung, Ressourcenplanung etc.
  • Aktivitäten zur Erweiterung des Serviceangebots und Kunden- , sowie Projektakquise

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes technisches Studium (Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik, Bauwesen oder gleichwertige Ausbildung) oder Techniker
  • mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Aufzugsindustrie oder Fachplanung Fördertechnik sowie vorzugsweise Erfahrung in der fachlichen Leitung
  • Gute Anwenderkenntnisse mit Elevate, AutoCAD und Lift Designer
  • Ausreichende Kenntnisse zu Planungsphasen, Aufzugsvorschriften und lokalen Bauvorschriften in Europa und Middle-East
  • sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Reisebereitschaft und hohe Motivation an internationaler Projektarbeit

Benefits

Warum Buro Happold?

Bei Buro Happold arbeitest Du an Projekten mit echtem Einfluss. Gemeinsam mit Expert:innen verschiedener Disziplinen entwickelst Du nachhaltige Lösungen für die gebaute Umwelt und profitierst von der Zusammenarbeit in einem internationalen Netzwerk. Dabei verbinden wir technische Exzellenz mit einer offenen, kollaborativen Kultur, in der Lernen, Weiterentwicklung und Teamarbeit im Mittelpunkt stehen.

Was wir bieten:

Flexibilität& Wellbeing

Flexible und hybride Arbeitsmodelle, Wellbeing-Initiativen und Unterstützungsangebote, die Dir helfen, Beruf und Privatleben in Einklang zu bringen.

Meaningful Work & Global Collaboration

Die Möglichkeit, an spannenden und herausfordernden Projekten mit lokalem und internationalem Einfluss zu arbeiten und dabei mit multidisziplinären Teams aus unserem globalen Netzwerk zusammenzuarbeiten.

Learning, Development & Career Growth

Klare Karrierepfade, regelmäßige Entwicklungsgespräche sowie interne und externe Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten zur Unterstützung Deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung.

Reward & Recognition

Regelmäßige Gehaltsüberprüfungen sowie leistungsbezogene Bonusmöglichkeiten, die Deinen Beitrag und Erfolg anerkennen.

Inclusive Culture & Community

Ein kollaboratives und inklusives Umfeld mit zahlreichen Möglichkeiten zum Wissensaustausch, Networking sowie regelmäßigen Team- und Community-Events.

Innovation & International Opportunities

Die Chance, eigene Ideen einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und internationale Entwicklungs- und Karrieremöglichkeiten zu nutzen.

Agile Working Environment

Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege, die schnelle Zusammenarbeit und eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten ermöglichen.

Zusätzlich in Deutschland

  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Zugang zu unserem Mental Wellbeing Programme
  • Flexibles Benefitprogramm für Fitness, Mobilität, Altersvorsorge und mehr
  • Sprachkurse
  • Lunch Roulette
  • Young Employee Forum
  • Regelmäßige Team- und Social Events

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? - Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung.

Werde Teil unseres Berliner Teams und gestalte mit uns nachhaltige Lösungen für die Herausforderungen der gebauten Umwelt.

title: Working Student - Online Marketing Coordination  (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Clariness
description_html:
Clariness is looking for a Working Student - Online Marketing Coordination -  based remotely within Germany.

- Part-time; limited -

About the role: 

As a Working Student - Online Marketing Coordination, you will support our Online Marketing team in delivering engaging digital marketing initiatives that connect patients with clinical research opportunities. Working alongside experienced marketing professionals, you'll gain hands-on experience in content creation, digital campaigns, SEO and performance analysis while contributing to meaningful healthcare projects. Because you'll be creating and supporting content for our German-speaking audience, native-level German and fluent English are essential for success in this role.


As a Working Student - Online Marketing Coordination , you would be responsible for:

  • Support the planning, coordination and execution of digital marketing campaigns across multiple online channels.
  • Assist in creating and optimising digital content, including website content, newsletters, landing pages and social media materials.
  • Contribute to SEO initiatives through keyword research, on-page optimisation and website performance monitoring.
  • Monitor campaign performance, compile reports and provide insights to support continuous optimisation.
  • Conduct market, competitor and audience research to help identify opportunities for improving patient recruitment campaigns.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across Online Marketing and other internal teams to support shared business objectives.
  • Provide operational and administrative support to the Online Marketing team and assist with additional marketing projects as required.

We would like you to have: 

  • Fluent German language skills (C2) and fluent English (C1/C2).
  • Enrolled at a German university, ideally studying Marketing, Communication Science, Digital Media, or a related field.
  • A basic understanding of digital marketing channels such as Google Ads, Meta (Facebook & Instagram) and Reddit.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn new digital marketing tools and techniques.
  • An interest in healthcare, clinical trials or the pharmaceutical industry is highly desirable.
  • Previous exposure to digital marketing through internships, university projects or part-time work is advantageous but not essential.

You may ask now, why should I work for you? Let us give you a few reasons – and you'll learn more during the process.

  • A varied and exciting job with a lot of personal responsibility in an international company, where you can develop and expand your skills.
  • Professional and personal development opportunities, including a personal development budget.
  • Flexible working hours and remote working.
  • Regular team events and an open feedback culture.
  • A versatile field of activity and challenging projects.
  • A supportive and open company culture, providing the opportunity to collaborate with a diverse and professional team.
  • Make a meaningful impact on healthcare by helping accelerate access to clinical trials and innovative treatments for patients worldwide.

How to apply & what to expect: 

  • Apply via link (CV only; no cover letter required).
  • Introductory call (30 min) → Technical interview → Senior Leadership Interview → Decision.
  • We aim to move promptly and keep you updated at every step. 

At Clariness, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

For more information, feel free to reach out to

Have we sparked your interest?

Would you like to become part of our dynamic, curious, and international culture with plenty of room for your ideas and creativity in an inspiring atmosphere? If so, we look forward to receiving your application with details of your desired salary and possible starting date, preferably via our application portal.

Clariness GmbH will treat the above information strictly confidential and will especially observe the applicable provisions of the applicable data protection laws. Further information about the use of the applicant data, you will find in the data protection declaration online at https://www.clariness.com/privacy-policy/

title: Solutions Architect
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Chainalysis
description_html:
Our Solutions Architecture team understands high-level business strategy and translates it into technical requirements for our customers. We love figuring out ways to stretch the limits of what is technically possible. Our job is to provide technical leadership and guidance to customers, prospects, and partners, helping them visualise the steps to achieve their business objectives, and then delivering the outcome with them.

This role spans the whole customer journey. Before the sale, you are the technical lead alongside our Sales team, shaping the solution and earning the technical win. After the sale, you stay with the customer and deliver it, owning the hands-on work that turns a signed contract into a working, adopted capability. You own the outcome, not just the design. When a customer asks a question, you answer it.

As a Solutions Architect, you'll develop a deep understanding of Chainalysis' solutions and offerings, explaining complex topics to a variety of audiences in a compelling yet understandable way. You'll directly impact some of our most strategic private sector customers, and throughout all of these activities you'll provide feedback that improves the value and experience customers have with Chainalysis' solutions.

In this role, you'll:

  • Partner with the Sales team as the technical lead, running discovery, demonstrations, and proofs of value, and leading the discussions on value creation and solution development that achieve the technical win

  • Design customer-specific solutions for the deployment and integration of Chainalysis products, and give guidance on technical challenges ranging from high-level architecture to code implementation

  • Own the post-sale customer experience end to end, configuring, deploying, and tuning our products yourself rather than coordinating others who do it, and working alongside customer teams so they become self-sufficient

  • Drive sustained adoption and measurable value, from fast onboarding through to the ongoing work of monitoring usage, reviewing product health, tuning rules and alerts, and intervening when adoption slips

  • Map customer workflows to capabilities across the product suite, including investigations, compliance, security, and data analysis solutions

  • Investigate using Chainalysis tooling to a competent standard, tracing, attributing, and analysing on the platform, so you can surface actionable insights and integrate Chainalysis into the customer's compliance and risk workflows

  • Be the person customers look to for answers, resolving technical, compliance, analytical, and operational questions directly, and owning time-sensitive decisions by validating signals quickly and moving the right matters through the correct escalation path

  • Communicate and translate complex technical requirements to our Product and Engineering teams, including data gaps such as unclustered or unattributed services that you find in the field

  • Become a trusted technical advisor to both internal and external customers, identifying business opportunities and substantially increasing our foothold with private sector customers and prospects

We're looking for candidates who have:

  • Worked in or directly with our private sector customer types: banks, cryptocurrency exchanges, payment processors, and blockchain developers

  • Practical understanding of compliance, investigative, and risk workflows, and can speak credibly from practitioner experience in investigations, compliance, fraud, risk, or security

  • A technical generalist background, comfortable with REST API integrations and familiar with how data is structured in SQL, and always interested in learning more

  • Experience of account or customer management for an enterprise SaaS business, including commercial awareness and partnering with sales counterparts on renewals and expansion

  • The ability to communicate clearly with both technical and executive audiences

  • Curiosity, fast learning, and motivation to solve difficult customer problems

  • A collaborative approach and generosity with knowledge

  • Fluency in English

Nice to have experience:

  • Financial compliance and anti-money laundering obligations

  • Proficiency in Python, REST API integrations, and SQL databases

  • Hands-on use of AI tooling to improve delivery quality or speed

  • Experience handling sensitive data and proprietary methods, and protecting them while using them effectively

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Omaze
description_html:
Senior Platform Engineer

🌍 Location: Holborn, London

⭐ Office Policy: Hybrid: 3 days a week in office

Who We Are

At Omaze, we give our community in the UK and Germany the chance to win luxury homes and other life-changing prizes — all while raising money for the causes they love.

Thanks to our Omaze Community, we’ve raised over £120 million for UK charities in just five years. That’s millions helping organisations like Age UK, the RSPCA, British Heart Foundation and Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity deliver life-saving work.

And the best part? We’re only just getting started. Omaze is building a business and culture committed to growth and creating significant social impact on a global scale.

Why You’ll Love Working at Omaze

  • Growth: Omaze is one of the fastest-growing companies in the world.

  • Impact: Join a team of world changers dedicated to creating a ripple effect of good.

  • Pioneering: Be part of something no one has done before.

  • Culture: We work hard, grow together, and spread joy along the way.

🔑 About The Job

As a Senior Platform Engineer at Omaze, you take genuine ownership of the infrastructure and reliability foundations that everything else depends on. You're experienced across AWS, particularly Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB and the serverless patterns that underpin our platform. You know how to build and maintain infrastructure that's secure, observable, cost-efficient at scale and globally distributed. You work in code - IaC isn't an afterthought for you, it's how you think. You bring the kind of judgement that comes from having run production systems under real pressure, and you apply that same rigour to the developer experience because a platform team that makes engineers faster is a force multiplier for the whole organisation.

🔧 What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the design, implementation, and evolution of Omaze's cloud infrastructure on AWS, Lambda, API Gateway, and surrounding services, written and maintained as code using CDK and / or Terraform.

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions that are fast, reliable, and give engineers confidence to ship frequently and safely.

  • Drive observability across the platform via instrumentation, alerting, dashboards, and on-call tooling so the team can detect, diagnose, and resolve incidents quickly.

  • Own security and compliance posture across the infrastructure: IAM, secrets management, network boundaries, and regulatory requirements, identifying risk early and remediating it properly.

  • Identify and act on cost optimisation opportunities, tracking resource utilisation, rightsizing infrastructure, and making spend visible and understandable across engineering.

  • Raise the baseline for developer experience by reducing toil, improving deployment workflows, and making the right way to do things the easy way.

  • Hold a high bar in infrastructure code review by giving feedback that's direct, constructive, and focused on long-term maintainability and security.

  • Use AI-assisted tooling as a natural part of your workflow and apply the same rigour and judgement to AI-generated infrastructure code as you would to anything hand-written.

🤩 About You

  • Significant experience as a Platform, Infrastructure, or DevOps engineer, with a strong AWS background and hands-on serverless experience (Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway, event-driven architectures).

  • Production-grade IaC experience with Terraform and/or AWS CDK. You write infrastructure the same way you write application code: tested, reviewed, and version controlled.

  • Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines, particularly GitHub Actions, and a track record of improving deployment reliability and developer velocity.

  • Deep familiarity with observability tooling and incident response practices. You've been on-call and know what good looks like.

  • Solid understanding of cloud security principles: IAM, least privilege, secrets management, network security, and compliance requirements in regulated environments.

  • Experience tracking and optimising cloud costs. You understand the levers and know how to make trade-offs without compromising reliability.

  • Comfortable working closely with other engineering teams translating infrastructure complexity into clear patterns and guardrails teams can follow confidently.

  • A clear communicator who can make the case for the platform as a product investment to both technical and non-technical audiences.

🙌 What’s In It For You

  • Generous stock options scheme

  • Private medical and dental insurance

  • 9% employer pension contributions, when you contribute at least 2%

  • A personal learning and development budget each year to use on training courses, conferences and professional memberships

  • Enhanced family leave policies

  • Life assurance of 4x your salary

Diversity statement

We actively seek out diversity of thought and experience to drive innovation. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and perspectives and work hard to ensure that every Omaze employee can bring their authentic self to work at all times.

About us:

Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.

Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.

Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it.

If you are passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences and building lasting client relationships, we would love to connect with you about joining our rapidly growing team as a Customer Success Manager. About the Role:

Join Camunda as the Manager of Account Development and be at the forefront of our hyper-growth journey into new markets. In this dynamic role, you will take charge of pipeline generation for one of our EMEA ADR teams, closely collaborating with cross-functional teams across Sales, Marketing, Partner Management, and Customer Success. You will use your superpower in coaching to build and empower a high-performance team, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous development. This role not only demands strong leadership and management skills but also a passion for inspiring and uplifting your team to achieve their full potential.

What you'll be doing:

  •  Lead and develop a high-performing Account Development team, focusing on attracting, onboarding, and coaching team members to excel in their roles and eventually promote into future GTM roles.

    Serve as a trusted partner to Sales Leadership on all sales activities, strategies, and forecasting, leveraging data-led insights to drive results.

    Analyze pipeline management and team productivity metrics to identify areas for improvement and implement actionable recommendations that lead to pipeline growth

    Champion a culture of continuous feedback and growth, building a team environment that encourages innovation and celebrates achievements.

What you bring:

  • Proven experience in leading high-performing global account development teams within a SaaS environment.

  • Strong analytical skills with experience in utilizing CRM for pipeline management and data analysis.

  • Exceptional people management skills and a demonstrated commitment to employee development and career growth.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Knowledge of modern sales strategies and methodologies to enhance team effectiveness.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

title: Founding Commercial SDR - London
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at BLP Digital AG
description_html:
Join BLP Digital — The #1 Solution for ERP Automation

BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. We solve real enterprise problems with cutting-edge technology and a strong sense of ownership.

Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 550+ customers, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base.

We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK and USA. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? Join BLP Digital today.

What the job actually feels like

Most SDR jobs end when the meeting gets booked. This one starts there. You'll hear "no" ten times before you hear "yes." That "yes" is a 30-minute discovery call with a CFO, CPO or CIO at a Fortune 500 manufacturer, where you run the meeting, present the value proposition, and build the stakeholder map live. The Senior SDRs who win here treat every "no" as a data point and every "yes" as a chair at the table.

 

About the role

As a Founding Commercial Sales Development Representative, you will own the outreach into Commercial manufacturing and industrial accounts. You'll work closely with our Sales team to prospect and nurture relationships with CFO, CPO, CEO and CIO stakeholders, and drive sales opportunities for our Agentic AI platform automating Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash. You will have a proactive approach and work to accelerate the sales process, convert leads into qualified opportunities, and consistently hit sales targets.

 

Tech stack

You will work with a sharp outbound stack: HubSpot as our CRM and source of truth, Clay for enrichment and signal-based prospecting, Claude for AI assisted tasks and research, and LinkMatch to keep LinkedIn and HubSpot in sync without manual logging.

 

What you'll do

  • Take ownership of strategic outreach into Commercial manufacturing and industrial accounts through cold calls and personalized messages, engaging CFO, CPO, CEO and CIO stakeholders.

  • Craft tailored value propositions by understanding the unique pain points of stakeholders across Finance, Procurement, and IT in Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash processes.

  • Prospect large accounts and build multi-threaded stakeholder maps across Finance, Procurement, IT and the executive sponsor.

  • Run and present in 30-minute discovery calls with C-level stakeholders. You own the meeting, not just the booking.

  • Stay ahead of the market by continuously updating your commercial knowledge, analysing procurement and finance processes, and tracking industry trends in Agentic AI and ERP automation.

  • Prioritise complex tasks with clients, flagging bottlenecks early rather than late to keep things moving forward.

  • Carry a quota of 1.2M ARR closed-won sourced per year.

 

We're excited about you because

  • You have 2-4 years of experience in a B2B SaaS sales environment, ideally selling into manufacturing, industrial or finance/procurement buyers, and a track record of building stakeholder maps in commercial accounts while consistently exceeding sales targets.

  • You communicate clearly, concisely, and persuasively, with the ability to adapt your style to a CFO, CPO, CEO or CIO conversation.

  • You handle rejection with resilience and keep your momentum through long, multi-stakeholder commercial sales cycles.

  • You're a team player with a sense of ownership and accountability.

  • You enjoy problem-solving and have a natural curiosity that drives you to find creative solutions.

  • Bonus Points: You have experience selling into Manufacturing, Industrial or Finance/procurement buyers, are familiar with ERP systems or sales tech such as Hubspot and Claude.

 

What you'll get

  • Training and development. Enjoy a 3-month onboarding process with ongoing support to set you up for success.

  • Fair lead allocation. We make sure the playing field is level for everyone. AI algorithms decide, not managers.

  • High earning potential. Uncapped commission and expected 6-figure package, and opportunity to participate in common share equity program.

  • Equal OTEs. As we share the same incentives, you'll be comped as the Account Executives.

  • Flexible locations. Zurich, Munich, Cologne, London. Come work in one of our offices. If you are not based in Zurich, you are welcome to visit your colleagues regularly.

  • Opportunities to grow. You're controlling your personal development and career trajectory in a rapidly growing, internationally expanding startup.

  • Exceptional colleagues. You'll be growing alongside individuals from exceptional academic backgrounds and careers.

 

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

As a Front-End Web Specialist, you’ll be the connective tissue between our web team and the rest of the business. This role exists because great websites aren’t just built — they’re coordinated, prioritised, and protected from chaos. Sitting at the intersection of Marketing and Web Development, you’ll own the intake and lifecycle of web requests, ensure every project is properly scoped before it touches the dev queue, and support the team in delivering an ambitious web roadmap.

But this role doesn’t stop at coordination. You’ll also be hands-on in the quality of what we ship — reviewing copy and UX before pages go live, supporting CRO initiatives, and acting as a critical second pair of eyes on every significant release. You care as much about whether a page converts as whether it launches on time.

If you’re someone who thrives on bringing order to complexity, understands how a website is actually built, and can hold your own in a room with developers, designers, and marketers alike, this is your role.


What You’ll Do

Technical Ownership & QA

  • Build and ship pages/components directly in Storyblok CMS: component configuration, staging, QA, and production deployment across market versions

  • QA every release technically — rendering, functionality, and cross-browser/device behaviour, not just copy and visual polish

  • Use AI tools as a core part of daily production work (drafting, layout variants, QA support), and know where AI output still needs a human check, particularly around localisation nuance and experiment validity

Request Triage & Scoping

  • Own intake for web requests: qualify, triage, and estimate technical complexity and dependencies before anything is scoped or scheduled

  • Enforce briefing standards and know enough technically to explain why a brief is incomplete

  • Decide what can be handled directly vs. what needs to go to the development team, and write specs the team can act on without excessive clarification

Project Coordination

  • Act as day-to-day PM between the development team and business stakeholders: track scope, delivery, and risk

  • Maintain the web backlog and sprint board with clear status, ownership, and blockers

  • Support CRO initiatives: help build A/B test setups, document hypotheses, and track experiment results

Process & Reporting

  • Maintain intake templates, briefing standards, and triage criteria

  • Produce regular status updates and pipeline reports for the Head of Web and wider leadership


What We’re Looking For

Must-haves

  • 2 to 4 years in a web operations, technical/digital project management, or web production role, ideally with hands-on CMS or front-end exposure — not purely marketing coordination

  • Working technical literacy: solid HTML/CSS fundamentals, understanding of how a CMS is structured (Storyblok, Contentful, Webflow or similar), staging vs. production workflows, and what a QA process actually checks

  • Comfortable using AI tools hands-on in production (prompting for drafts, QA’ing AI output) and able to articulate where AI isn’t reliable enough to trust unsupervised

  • Product/project-management instincts: can scope a request, size complexity, sequence competing priorities, and brief external developers with minimal hand-holding

  • Confident translating between technical and non-technical stakeholders, and comfortable pushing back on a brief or a deadline when needed

  • Strong written communication: a clear brief, a precise QA note, a concise status update

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Storyblok or a comparable headless CMS

  • Familiarity with web analytics or conversion tracking concepts

  • Exposure to A/B testing/CRO tools, or basic SQL

  • Experience briefing or QA’ing a development team

  • Basic understanding of Core Web Vitals / page performance

  • Familiarity with SEO fundamentals as they intersect with web production


What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12–16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 “Work from Anywhere” days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.
