title: Marketing Manager - Manda
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at iwoca
description_html:
The company

It's still difficult for business owners to sell their business, or buy others, in the sub-£10m enterprise value market. Information asymmetry, lack of knowledge and low transaction values make it hard, and most M&A firms shy away from the segment because they can't serve it profitably. A generation of owner-managers is approaching retirement, and most of them have no realistic route to a sale.

manda exists to fix that. We match buyers with sellers in the part of the market everyone else ignores, and we finance acquisitions ourselves so buyers arrive pre-qualified and often pre-financed. We've sold the first businesses, funded the first acquisition loans, and we're now opening the platform up beyond the businesses that already bank with us.

manda is part of iwoca, one of Europe's leading fintech lenders. Since 2012 iwoca has provided more than £4 billion in funding and its mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments. That backing is why we can serve this market where others can't: a deep footprint in the SME economy with 150,000+ UK customers, the data and infrastructure of an established lender, and the ability to build clean, automated processes instead of running an advisory firm on spreadsheets.

We're looking for a Marketing Manager to own how business owners find manda, iwoca's M&A platform. You'll be our first marketing hire, joining as we open the platform to business owners who don't yet bank with iwoca. Almost everything about how we reach them is still to be decided, and you'll be the one deciding it.

The team

You'll be our first marketing hire, joining a founding team of circa 10 mandans. All highly motivated to finally free the SME M&A space from the lack of meaningful innovation in the space.

You'll get the autonomy and pace of a startup, with the data, infrastructure and credibility of an established lender behind you. You'll report directly into the Venture Lead of manda.

Your mission

Your mission is to bring the right business owners to manda: people genuinely thinking about selling, at the point in their lives when they're thinking about it.

Today almost all of our sellers come from iwoca's own customer base, found by hand and worked one at a time. That works, but it doesn't scale and the pool is finite. Your job is to build the channels that reach owners who have never heard of iwoca, work out which of those channels produce real mandates at a cost our fee model can support, and shut down the ones that don't.

You won't be inheriting a growth engine. We're launching our direct application journey this autumn, and filling it is your first job. You'll be building the first growth engine here, and you'll be the person who decides where the money goes.

The role

Find the channels that work

  • Run cheap, fast tests across direct channels such as paid search, paid social, organic, and direct response. Prioritise those that work and kill the ones that don't, based on evidence.

  • Own the budget and the allocation decisions. You'll start small on purpose: we'd rather learn which channel works than spend heavily on one that doesn't.

  • Write and test the copy yourself, from ads to landing pages, and iterate on what real business owners actually respond to.

  • Test offline as well as digital. Mail and email direct to business owners are two of the few ways to reach someone who isn't actively searching for a way out, and nobody has tested either properly for us yet.

  • Earn coverage in the trade press. We have real deals to talk about now, and working with iwoca's comms team you should be able to turn them into a steady source of inbound interest.

Prove the unit economics

  • Establish what it actually costs us to acquire a seller mandate through each channel. We have an assumption in our financial model and nobody has yet tested it — replacing it with a real number is one of the most valuable things you can do in your first six months.

  • Define how we value a lead before it becomes a deal. Our conversion event is months away from first contact and worth a lot when it lands, so you'll need a sensible proxy to steer spend against.

Build the measurement first

  • Set up attribution, with needed tech support, so that customers can be traced back to the channel that produced them.

  • Build the reporting that tells the team which channels are working, and be the person who questions a number that looks too good.

Turn our website into something that converts

  • Make the case for manda clearly: what the process involves, how long each step takes, and why we're different from a traditional broker.

  • Use our completed deals, our team's track record and our acquisition finance offering as proof, and test what actually persuades a cautious owner to start a conversation about selling.

Help us reach better buyers

  • Sellers come first, but manda is a two-sided market. Once seller supply is working, you'll help us reach acquirers who are serious, credible and ready to transact, including buyers who are new to iwoca.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Around 4+ years in acquisition, growth or generalist marketing, ideally in a startup, scale-up or new venture where you had to work out what to do rather than execute someone else's plan.

  • M&A, marketplace or two-sided experience, especially where supply rather than demand was the constraint.

  • Comfortable with a long, low-frequency, high-value conversion. Selling a business is nothing like taking out a loan: the cycle runs for months, volumes are low, and you'll have to make decisions on thin and noisy data without waiting for statistical comfort.

  • Numerate and data-literate. You build the measurement before the campaign, you can read a funnel, and you're happy owning the numbers you report.

  • Genuinely hands-on. There's no team and no agency to hide behind: you'll write the copy, brief the page, set up the tracking and pull the reporting yourself.

title: Partnerships Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at iwoca
description_html:
The company

It's still difficult for business owners to sell their business, or buy others, in the sub-£10m enterprise value market. Information asymmetry, lack of knowledge and low transaction values make it hard, and most M&A firms shy away from the segment because they can't serve it profitably. A generation of owner-managers is approaching retirement, and most of them have no realistic route to a sale.

manda exists to fix that. We match buyers with sellers in the part of the market everyone else ignores, and we finance acquisitions ourselves so buyers arrive pre-qualified and often pre-financed. We've sold the first businesses, funded the first acquisition loans, and we're now opening the platform up beyond the businesses that already bank with us.

manda is part of iwoca, one of Europe's leading fintech lenders. Since 2012 iwoca has provided more than £4 billion in funding and its mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments. That backing is why we can serve this market where others can't: a deep footprint in the SME economy with 150,000+ UK customers, the data and infrastructure of an established lender, and the ability to build clean, automated processes instead of running an advisory firm on spreadsheets.

We’re looking for a Partnership Manager - manda (iwoca's M&A Platform)

We're looking for someone to build the introducer network that brings business owners to manda, iwoca's M&A platform. Accountants, solicitors, wealth managers and brokers meet an owner who is thinking about retiring long before we do. Your job is to make sure that when they do they think of us, and that referring us is the easiest thing they do that day.

The role

Your mission is to build a referral channel that produces a steady flow of business owners who are genuinely ready to sell.

Today almost all of our sellers come from iwoca's own customer base, found by hand and worked one at a time. That works, but the pool is finite. The professionals who already advise business owners are the most credible route to the ones we'd otherwise never reach, and right now we have no systematic way of working with them.

You'll be starting from close to nothing, so the first version of this channel is yours to design. It also means the job is as much about making referrals actually arrive as it is about signing partners up.

It also has to scale. In this industry most partner flow still depends on people turning up at industry events, which works but stops the moment you stop showing up. We're after the version of this channel where referring a client to manda takes a couple of clicks inside the software an adviser already uses.

Key responsibilities include:

Build the introducer network

  • Find and win the firms worth working with: accountancy practices, corporate finance boutiques, solicitors, wealth managers and business transfer agents. Work out which kinds of firm actually refer, and concentrate there.

  • Do the outbound yourself. Identify the firm, get the meeting, make the case, and follow up until something happens.

  • Design what we offer them: how a referral is made, what the partner gets, what we commit to in return, and how we keep them informed once their client is with us.

Make referrals actually arrive

  • A signed partnership is worth nothing until a referral comes through. You'll own the ongoing relationship work that turns agreements into a flow: regular contact, keeping manda front of mind, briefing partner teams, and being the person they call.

  • Track referral volume and quality by partner, and be honest about which relationships aren't working so we can stop spending time on them.

Make the channel scale

  • Judge every partnership by whether it adds referrals without adding work. A relationship that only produces when you're in the room isn't a channel yet.

  • Work out which partner technology is worth plugging into: the practice management and accounting software advisers already work in, tracked referral links and partner portals, and integrations that let a firm refer a client without leaving their own tools. You won't build these yourself, but you'll identify them, make the commercial case, and scope them with our Product Builder.

  • Look for partners who can bring a book rather than one client at a time. One firm with hundreds of owner-managed clients is worth more to us than ten firms with five, if we can find a way to surface the right candidates across the whole book.

Work iwoca's existing network

  • iwoca already has a broker network and a partnerships function with relationships across the SME economy. Working out where manda fits into those relationships is far faster than starting cold, and it's the first place to look.

Events and community

  • Build a focused programme of events worth attending and, where it makes sense, running our own: succession and exit planning, accountancy and adviser events, industry gatherings, and business owner peer communities.

  • Judge them on referrals rather than attendance, and stop going to the ones that don't produce. Events are how you find and land partners, not how the channel scales.

Prove the channel pays

  • Establish what a referral actually costs us once your time, any partner incentives and events are counted, and how many convert into a signed mandate. We have an assumption in our financial model and nobody has yet tested it.

The requirements

We look for people who are smart, humble, motivated and who are always looking to improve.

Essential:

  • Around 4+ years in partnerships, channel or business development, ideally B2B, where you built or substantially grew a referral channel rather than inheriting one that already worked.

  • You've done the full cycle yourself: identified the target firms, got the meetings, agreed the terms, and then managed the relationship afterwards.

  • A background in M&A, marketplaces, business broking or business transfer.

  • You understand that the work starts after the agreement is signed, and you have the discipline to keep a channel warm over months rather than weeks.

  • Numerate and honest about performance. You track referrals by partner, you know which relationships are producing, and you say so when one isn't.

  • You think in systems as well as relationships. You can tell the difference between a partnership that scales and one that only works while you're pushing it, and you'd rather replace your own manual work with an integration than defend it.

  • Comfortable specifying technology without building it. You can look at a partner's tools and our product, work out what would make us the path of least resistance, and scope it clearly enough for a product team to build.

  • Genuinely hands-on. There's no team to delegate to: you'll build the target list, send the emails, run the meetings and keep the CRM straight yourself.

  • A commercial thinker with a bias for action, comfortable navigating ambiguity in an early-stage venture.

Bonus:

  • Experience with accountancy, legal or wealth management channels specifically.

  • Experience running an event programme with commercial targets attached to it.

  • Familiarity with the UK succession and exit planning landscape.

  • Comfortable treating a CRM as a discipline rather than an afterthought, ideally HubSpot.

  • You've shipped a partner integration, an embedded referral flow or a software marketplace listing, or worked closely with a product team on one.

  • Familiar with the software UK accountancy practices and advisers actually work in, such as Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, IRIS or Dext.

The salary

We expect to pay £55,000–£80,000 and an annual performance based bonus for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

description_html:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role

We are looking for a seasoned IT Engineer II to join our Engineering team. At this level, you have developed your skill set to confidently tackle all but the most complex problems affecting the team. You will lead the delivery of essential IT services and small to medium-sized projects, either independently or by guiding other engineers.

 

As an Engineer II, you are an individual contributor with a deep understanding of your team’s purpose and how it impacts Checkout as a whole. You will act as an owner-operator, taking accountability for the success of the systems within your area of responsibility.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Project Leadership: Independently design and deliver project-level work with minimal guidance from senior engineers.

  • Atlassian Mastery: Act as a subject matter expert for our Workplace Technology stack, with a specific focus on high-level administration and optimisation of Jira and Confluence.

  • Endpoint & Infrastructure: Provide advanced technical support and policy management for macOS and Windows endpoints using Jamf and Microsoft Intune.

  • Operational Excellence: Provide an advanced level of operational support on team-owned services and train new members on service design, security, and operations.

  • Incident Response: Display urgency and accountability during incidents, triaging and supporting complex flows unaided.

  • Mentorship: Regularly support and mentor less experienced engineers, helping to raise the technical quality of the team.

  • Automation: Proactively recognise areas for improvement and suggest automated solutions (Python/PowerShell) to reduce incidental complexity.

 

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: Typically 2–3+ years of experience in an IT Engineering or similar technical role.

  • Technical Expertise: Experience with Identity Providers (Okta, Azure AD) and protocols like SAML and SCIM.

  • Advanced Atlassian Skills: High-level experience managing the Atlassian suite. You should be comfortable with complex Jira configurations, workflow customisations, and permission schemes.

  • Problem Solving: A logical approach to troubleshooting, with the ability to articulate technical trade-offs between different solutions.

  • Ownership: A proactive "owner-operator" mindset—you take responsibility for your tasks and the long-term health of the systems you manage.

  • Communication: Ability to communicate effectively with company stakeholders and resolve complex support queries within your area of focus.

Adaptability: Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where you can balance temporary workarounds with flexible, long-term architectural solutions.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

title: Senior IT Solution Architect (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at noris network AG
description_html:
Die noris network AG steht für innovative, sichere und nachhaltige IT-Lösungen. Mit über 600 engagierten Mitarbeitenden entwickeln wir leistungsstarke Services in den Bereichen Cloud, Datacenter, Network & Security sowie Managed Applications – betrieben auf einer hochmodernen, mehrfach zertifizierten IT-Infrastruktur mit eigenen Hochsicherheitsrechenzentren. Seit 1993 sind wir kontinuierlich gewachsen und zählen heute zu den führenden IT-Spezialisten in Deutschland. Unser größtes Kapital? Ein starkes, diverses Team mit einem gemeinsamen Ziel: die digitale Zukunft unserer Kunden aktiv mitzugestalten. Deshalb fördern wir Eigenverantwortung, Weiterentwicklung und frische Ideen – in einem Umfeld, das Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit vereint.

Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt? Dann bewirb Dich an unseren Standorten in Nürnberg, Aschheim, Berlin oder remote (innerhalb Deutschlands).

Unser Team Product & Solution Design entwickelt und dokumentiert die technischen Konzepte für die Implementierung und die nachfolgende Integration von Lösungen und Produkten (Services) in den Betrieb und berät die Kunden in Bezug auf Designfragen ihrer IT-Landschaft.

Aufgaben

  • Steuerung der technischen Entwicklung von Produkten (IT-Services) auf der Plattform- und Applikationsebene
  • Sehr enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Produktmanagement im Rahmen von Angebotsprozessen
  • Strukturierte Einbindung der fachspezifischen Technik-Teams und Systemarchitekten sowie externer Partner
  • Mitarbeit bei der technologischen Weiterentwicklung zentraler Betriebsplattformen
  • Technische Beratung von Kunden (branchenübergreifend) zu Lösungsplattformen
  • Erstellung von Design Guides und Blueprints sowie Coaching von KollegInnen zu technologischen Fragen

Qualifikation

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, erfolgreich abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung zum Fachinformatiker (m/w/d) für Systemintegration oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Weitreichende Erfahrung in der technischen Umsetzung von IT-Projekten und im IT-Betrieb
  • Erfahrung in der praktischen Anwendung von mehreren Technologien
  • Ausgeprägtes Verständnis von rechenzentrumsnahen IT-Services, hohe Kundenorientierung und Qualitätsbewusstsein
  • Zielorientierung und kreative Lösungskompetenz sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Repräsentationsfähigkeit
  • Selbstständige, eigenverantwortliche und kundenorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie Teamfähigkeit und unternehmerisches Handeln
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Benefits

  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag und flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Arbeiten an verschiedenen Standorten möglich (z.B. Nürnberg, Aschheim, Berlin) oder auch zu 100% Remote
  • Hochwertiges Equipment: Laptop und Firmenhandy auch zur privaten Nutzung
  • Individuelle Förderung und Weiterentwicklung durch Inhouse-Trainings und externe Schulungen
  • Kinderbetreuungskostenzuschuss (pro Monat/Kind) und Corporate Benefits
  • Attraktive Firmenevents (inkl. Reisekostenübernahme), kollegiales und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld sowie Duz-Kultur ab dem ersten Tag
  • Großzügiger Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket
  • Gesundheitsmanagement (z.B. kostenlose Massagen inhouse), Jobrad Leasing und betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit Zuschuss
  • Welcome Day, direkter Ansprechpartner (m/w/d) und strukturierte Einarbeitungsphase
  • Getränke for free (auch Softdrinks) und frisches Obst an den Standorten

Dann freuen wir uns über Deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung mit Angabe Deiner Gehaltsvorstellung und dem frühesten Eintrittsdatum.
Für Deine Fragen zu uns oder der Stelle steht Dir Nicole Gebhard gerne zur Verfügung.

Aufgaben

Wir bringen zusammen, was zusammengehört. Dabei spielt das passende Tätigkeitsprofil natürlich eine entscheidende Rolle. Bei unserer Partnerkanzlei können Sie sich Ihren Aufgabenbereich auf Basis Ihrer persönlichen Stärken und Schwächen selbst zusammenstellen.

  • Weitere individuell wählbare Tätigkeitsbereiche, die Ihnen Freude bringen

Qualifikation

Am Ende sollte es für beide Seiten passen. Deshalb wäre es gut, wenn Sie sich in den folgenden Punkten wiederfinden.

  • Kommunikative Art und Freude am Austausch mit Mandanten
  • Sorgfältige, effiziente und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise
  • Offen für eine digitale Arbeitsweise
  • Führungsverständnis und Verantwortungsbewusstsein gegenüber Mitarbeitern (optional)
  • Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Steuerberaterexamen
  • Leidenschaft für steuerliche Themen

Benefits

Sie haben genug von 0815 Benefits, von denen Sie nicht wirklich profitieren? Dann sollten Sie einen Blick auf die nachfolgenden Benefits werfen.

  • Außerordentliche Vergütung von 90.000 € bis 130.000 € / Jahr, auf Wunsch auch Partnerperspektive
  • Flexible Gestaltung der Arbeitszeiten sowie die Option auf Home-Office
  • Nettolohnoptimierung mit monatlichen 50,00€ Sachbezugsgutscheinen
  • Umfangreiche Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen wie z.B. Fachberater Qualifikationen
  • Modernste Ausstattung mit digitalen Prozessen
  • Starker Teamzusammenhalt und regelmäßige Teamevents

Schnell, unkompliziert und effizient Ihren Traumjob finden – ein Versprechen an Sie, dass wir aufgrund unseres selektiven, breit gefächerten und deutschlandweiten Kanzleinetzwerks halten werden. lhre Vorteile mit uns auf einen Blick:

  • Sie führen keine unsinnigen Bewerbungsgespräche mehr, bei denen Sie während des Bewerbungsprozesses merken, dass es (bspw. wegen des Gehalts) sowieso nicht passt - wir klären vor Ihrem Bewerbungsgespräch all Ihre mit uns besprochenen Kriterien mit der Kanzlei ab.
  • Wir führen Ihre Gehaltsverhandlungen und kennen die Gehaltsstrukturen der Branche dabei bestens.
  • 100% Anonymität – solange Sie uns nicht das „Go“ geben und einem Kennenlernen mit Ihrem neuen potentiellen Arbeitgeber zustimmen, erfährt niemand von Ihrem Namen oder Ihren bisherigen Arbeitgebern – Ihre Ihnen wichtigen Kriterien können wir auch zunächst anonym mit unseren Partnerkanzleien klären.
  • Attraktive Kanzleien – die Kanzleien in unserem breit gefächerten Kanzleinetzwerk sind selektiv ausgewählt und heben sich klar von “normalen” Kanzleien ab (z.B. hinsichtlich der Vergütung, Benefits, Hierarchien, Digitalisierungsgrad, Ausstattung etc.).
  • Und das Beste: Unser gesamter Service ist unverbindlich und völlig kostenfrei für Sie.

title: Director, Integrated Marketing (R-19922)
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Dun & Bradstreet
description_html:
Shape the Future with Dun & Bradstreet
At Dun & Bradstreet, we believe data has the power to create a better tomorrow. As a global leader in business decisioning data and analytics, we help companies worldwide grow, manage risk, and innovate. Since 1841, businesses have trusted us to turn uncertainty into opportunity. We’re a diverse, global team that values creativity, collaboration, and bold ideas. Are you ready to make an impact and help shape what’s next? Join us! Explore opportunities at dnb.com/careers.

The Director, Integrated Marketing is a critical leadership role responsible for driving marketing strategy and business growth across key global markets and business segments. You'll lead integrated marketing programs that build brand awareness, generate demand, and deliver measurable impact on pipeline, revenue, customer acquisition, and retention.

Working closely with senior leaders across the business, you'll translate market opportunities and commercial priorities into innovative, customer-focused marketing initiatives. You'll oversee marketing performance and investment decisions, champion data-driven decision-making, and help shape the future direction of the business.

As a people leader, you'll inspire and develop a high-performing team while fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning. This is an opportunity to influence strategy at a senior level and make a significant impact on both marketing performance and overall business success.


Key Responsibilities:
  • Define and lead the integrated marketing strategy and long-term roadmap, ensuring alignment with business growth objectives and market opportunities.
  • Act as a strategic partner to senior business leaders, providing guidance on customer engagement, market trends, and growth opportunities.
  • Develop and execute marketing plans across multiple business units, industries, and international markets.
  • Set annual and quarterly marketing priorities that support business goals and go-to-market strategies.
  • Leverage customer insights, market intelligence, and competitive analysis to identify opportunities and inform strategic decisions.
  • Drive measurable business impact through marketing, including pipeline growth, customer acquisition, revenue contribution, and brand engagement.
  • Establish and monitor key performance metrics to evaluate marketing effectiveness and optimize return on investment.
  • Translate performance data and market insights into clear recommendations for business stakeholders and executive leadership.
  • Manage and optimize marketing investments across channels, programs, regions, and strategic initiatives.
  • Lead the development and delivery of integrated marketing campaigns across digital, content, communications, events, media, analyst relations, and field marketing.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to successfully launch new products, solutions, and strategic growth initiatives.
  • Create seamless and consistent customer experiences across the entire customer journey.
  • Foster strong cross-functional collaboration to ensure alignment between marketing, sales, product, and commercial teams.
  • Champion innovative marketing approaches, technologies, and customer engagement strategies to enhance performance and customer impact.
  • Lead planning and prioritization across global marketing teams to maximize business outcomes and execution excellence.
  • Influence strategic business decisions through data-driven insights, market intelligence, and compelling business cases.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of marketing professionals, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, and continuous learning.

    • About you:
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of B2B marketing experience, including senior leadership roles with responsibility for integrated marketing, demand generation, and go-to-market strategy.
  • Proven track record of leading and developing high-performing marketing teams in complex, fast-paced environments.
  • Experience shaping and executing global marketing strategies that drive business growth and support strategic priorities.
  • Demonstrated success delivering measurable business outcomes, including pipeline growth, revenue contribution, customer acquisition, and market expansion.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships and partner effectively with senior leaders.
  • Deep expertise in integrated marketing, customer engagement, brand development, and multi-channel demand generation.
  • Hands-on experience with modern marketing technologies and analytics platforms, including Eloqua, HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Analytics, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Proven ability to design and deliver integrated campaigns across digital, paid, earned, and owned channels that drive awareness, engagement, and commercial results.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to make informed decisions, prioritize investments, and maximize marketing impact and return on investment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and other business productivity tools.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset, with a natural curiosity and a passion for driving continuous improvement and business success.
  • A collaborative leadership style, with the ability to build strong relationships across teams, functions, and geographies.
  • A commitment to continuous learning and professional growth, with a desire to stay ahead of industry trends, emerging technologies, and evolving customer needs.
  • Interest in leveraging AI and emerging technologies to enhance marketing effectiveness, customer engagement, and team performance.

title: AI Analytics Account Executive
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Jobgether
description_html:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Analytics Account Executive based in United Kingdom.

This is a strategic sales role focused on accelerating growth across analytics, AI, and modern data platform solutions.
You will partner closely with enterprise Account Executives to identify opportunities, advance complex deals, and expand customer relationships.
The role combines deep expertise in analytics and AI with hands-on enterprise sales execution and consultative selling.
You will create new pipeline within existing accounts while helping sales teams position solutions around customer business priorities.
As a specialist overlay, you will influence multiple accounts and stakeholders while bringing strong domain expertise to the wider sales organisation.
You will engage senior technology and business leaders, navigate complex buying processes, and help customers modernize their data environments.
This is an opportunity to play a visible role in expanding adoption of data and AI technologies within a collaborative, high-performance EMEA sales environment.


Accountabilities
  • Partner with Account Executives and territory owners to accelerate active enterprise opportunities involving analytics, AI, data platforms, and related solutions.
  • Co-sell on complex opportunities, providing specialist domain expertise, customer insights, value propositions, and sales support throughout the deal cycle.
  • Design and execute targeted sales campaigns within existing customer accounts to uncover new analytics and AI opportunities and expand the commercial footprint.
  • Generate new pipeline proactively rather than relying solely on inbound opportunities.
  • Identify customer needs and connect analytics, AI, data modernization, cloud, and platform capabilities to measurable business outcomes.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for the broader sales organisation, providing current analytics messaging, competitive positioning, industry insights, and value propositions.
  • Enable Account Executives and other field teams to confidently position analytics and AI solutions with enterprise customers.
  • Work closely with account owners to integrate specialist solutions into broader account plans and territory strategies.
  • Engage credibly with senior technology and business executives, helping them understand the strategic and commercial value of modern data and AI capabilities.
  • Lead discovery, qualification, negotiation, forecasting, and closing activities for opportunities within your specialist area.
  • Apply structured enterprise sales methodologies, including MEDDIC, to qualify opportunities and progress complex buying processes.
  • Build strong relationships across multiple accounts and sales teams while influencing outcomes without directly owning the overall account relationship.
  • Maintain strong commercial ownership, urgency, accountability, and focus throughout the sales cycle.

description_html:
About Userlane

Userlane is a software adoption platform that shows enterprises whether their software and AI investments are actually working. Our team works with some of the biggest names in regulated industries, helping them get real value from technology and giving their employees the right support inside software applications they use every day. Based in Munich, growing internationally.

Userlane combines Application Intelligence and Contextual Assistance for regulated industries. Application Intelligence shows where software creates cost and friction across the estate. Contextual Assistance helps people get work done in the moment, without training burden. We work with healthcare organizations across the US and Europe, helping clinical and operational teams work confidently in complex systems like EHRs and other core clinical and business applications.


Your mission

Own Application Intelligence at Userlane. You'll shape what we build across App Discovery, HEART Analytics and Portfolio Overview to help enterprise CIOs and IT leaders see where software spending delivers value and where it creates waste. You'll work on opportunities such as:

  • Defining metrics that hold up: Own the methodology behind our HEART Analytics, deciding what each score measures, how it's calculated, and how it stays credible when data is incomplete.

  • Delivering outcome-linked metrics: Connect usage data to business outcomes like cost savings, efficiency and compliance risk that enterprise executives can take action on

  • Building for time-poor executives: Design analytics that bring insights to leaders and answers "what should I do?" not just "what happened?"

  • Connecting fragmented data sources: Define the integration strategy to combine Userlane behavioural data with cost data from SAM tools, license data from IT asset management and employee data from HR systems,

  • Transforming insights into action: Define what turns raw usage data into insights that drive action, not just dashboards people look at once

  • AI adoption governance: Extend analytics to measure how AI assistants and agents affect productivity, cost and ROI.


Your profile

  • 5+ years of product management experience on data/analytics products within a modern product organisation

  • You've defined a metrics methodology, scoring system or measurement framework that others build on, and you can defend the trade-offs behind it. You're comfortable reasoning about why one calculation approach produces misleading results in a specific scenario and another doesn't.

  • You start with the business question, not the data. Your first instinct is "what decision are they trying to make?" rather than "what data do we have?"

  • You hold your ground. You'll work with technically strong colleagues and leaders with well-formed opinions. You can disagree with them credibly, engage with their reasoning, and change your position when the evidence says so, not when the seniority does.

  • You can hold a credible conversation with data engineers and data scientists about what the data can and cannot prove, and you understand the difference between interesting data and actionable insight

  • You've worked in enterprise B2B (not B2C product analytics). Healthcare experience is a strong plus

  • You figure out what works by talking to customers and watching them use the product

  • You're capable of explaining things to engineers, salespeople, support agents and CEOs alike

  • You're fluent in English (spoken and written)


What's in for you

  • Team & Culture: A high-performance culture with great leadership and a fun, engaged, motivated and diverse team with people from over 20 countries

  • Impact: You'll be part of an empowered cross-functional team given the freedom and autonomy to solve real customer problems

  • Product strategy influence: Work directly with our VP Product to shape our 2026-2030 strategy as we expand into new sectors

  • Market: Userlane is among the global leaders in the rapidly growing Digital Adoption industry

  • Growth: We take you and your development seriously. You can expect weekly 121s, a personalised skills assessment and development plan, on-the-job coaching and budget for events and training
    Benefits: We offer flexible benefits related to savings and security, health and well-being, and lifestyle and leisure

title: Performance Marketing Manager, Paid Search
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Angi
description_html:
For over 30 years, Angi has powered the future of the home services industry, creating an environment where homeowners and pros benefit from more jobs done well.

For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you.

Angi at a glance:

  • Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021

  • Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide

  • Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting

About the role:

As the Paid Search Marketing Manager for the UK market, you will play a key role in driving growth and profitability through expertly managed paid search campaigns. You will have the opportunity to work on high-impact initiatives, shaping how we connect with both sides of our marketplace - homeowners and tradespeople. We are looking for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment and is committed to consistently improving performance while exploring new opportunities to innovate and expand. This role reports to a Paid Search Director.

What you’ll do:

  • Steward the day-to-day management and optimization of Google Ads and Microsoft Ads campaigns, ensuring they deliver maximum profitability.

  • Conduct in-depth keyword research, running ad copy tests, and analyzing performance to continually improve profitability and ROAS.

  • Partner with our Product and Analytics teams to implement advanced reporting and actionable insights.

  • Stay ahead of the curve by monitoring industry trends, testing new strategies, and exploring untapped opportunities for paid search growth.

  • Leverage AI tools and agents (e.g. Claude-based workflows, Google Ads Scripts automation) for campaign monitoring, reporting, and anomaly detection to work more efficiently and surface insights faster.

This role gives you the chance to make a real impact while working in an environment that encourages innovation and data-driven experimentation. Your contributions will directly shape the success of our paid marketing efforts in a key European market.

Who you are:

  • 2-4 years of experience in Paid Search Marketing, specifically with Google Ads and Microsoft Ads.

  • Experience with budget management, bid optimization, and performance tracking.

  • Analytical mindset with a focus on data-driven decision-making.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with display or video advertising as a supplementary skill.

  • Experience with marketplace management

  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) techniques.

  • Comfort working with AI tools and agents (e.g. Claude, automation scripts) to accelerate reporting and analysis — a definite plus, though not required.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • The salary band for this position ranges from £50,000 - 65,000, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

  • Hybrid work environment and home office set-up allowance

  • Temporary work from abroad policy

  • Regular team and social events

title: Solutions Architect, Voice - London
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Decagon
description_html:
About Decagon

Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.

Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.

We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.

We’re an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.

About the Role

Decagon is seeking a Solutions Architect – Voice, a technical hire who will define how enterprises deploy Decagon's AI agents into live voice and contact center environments. This role sits at the intersection of pre-sales engineering, telephony architecture, and enterprise contact center strategy. You will act as a trusted advisor to enterprise prospects and customers, guiding them through complex, ambiguous voice deployment conversations—from SIP trunking and call routing to media handling and real-time transcription—ensuring Decagon integrates seamlessly into their existing contact center platforms while meeting latency, reliability, and compliance requirements.

As an early hire in this function, you will define best practices for voice deployment solutioning, partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Engineering, and set the standard for how Decagon engages with enterprises running mission-critical contact center operations. You will establish technical credibility with stakeholders across the C-suite, telephony and network teams, contact center operations, and CX leadership.

In this role, you will

  • Partner with Account Executives to discover, qualify, and design voice deployment solutions that address customer telephony constraints and deliver measurable containment and CX outcomes.

  • Navigate ambiguous conversations about a customer's contact center landscape, translating diverse environments (Genesys Cloud CX & Engage, Amazon Connect, Cisco UCCE/CVP, Google CCAI) into clear integration and deployment strategies for Decagon's voice platform.

  • Design SIP integration approaches—BYOC trunking, REFER-based transfer, header propagation, and media/streaming paths (Websockets, Audio Connector, External Voice Transfer)—tailored to each customer's topology and security posture.

  • Diagnose complex, multi-leg call flows down to the packet level, and establish repeatable methods for tracing and resolving SIP and media issues in production.

  • Establish scalable pre-sales processes, deployment playbooks, and reusable reference architectures to support growth.

Your background looks something like this

  • 8–10+ years in customer-facing technical roles (Solutions Architect, Solutions Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Product Manager) with a focus on voice, telephony, or contact center platforms.

  • Deep fluency in enterprise contact center platforms—Genesys, Amazon Connect, Cisco, or Google CCAI—and the SIP/telephony fundamentals underneath them (trunking, transfer semantics, codecs, SRTP, DTMF).

  • Hands-on experience with CPaaS infrastructure such as Twilio or Telnyx, including BYOC configuration and programmable voice.

  • Demonstrated success navigating ambiguous technical conversations with enterprise customers, asking the right discovery questions, and collaborating through uncertainty.

  • Strong ability to engage diverse stakeholders—from network engineers to CX and contact center leaders—and translate voice requirements into actionable deployment strategies.

Even better if you have

  • 2+ years selling or architecting AI/ML or conversational voice solutions in enterprise environments.

  • Experience in a high-growth startup where you built pre-sales practices from the ground up.

  • Hands-on packet-level SIP diagnostics experience (pcap analysis, Wireshark/Scapy) and comfort reading raw signaling.

  • Familiarity with real-time speech stacks (STT/TTS), call recording and compliance patterns (SIPREC), and multi-leg call correlation.

Benefits

We proudly offer the following benefits for our full-time employees:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life Insurance and Disability Benefits

  • Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension)

  • Parental Leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work-life balance

  • Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best

  • Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave)

These benefits are described in more detail in Decagon’s policies, may vary by location, and can change at any time according to applicable compensation and benefits plans.

Compensation: £144.3K – £216.4K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission

title: Senior Agent Product Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Decagon
description_html:
About Decagon

Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.

Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.

We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.

We’re an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.

About the Team

When a Fortune 500 C-suite brings in Decagon, they are not buying a support tool. They are buying a transformation of how their customers experience their brand, end to end. Agent Product Managers are the people they trust to make that transformation real.

Your counterpart is the C-suite, and what they are asking you to transform is their entire customer experience. You define the roadmap, the frameworks, and the decision-making models that make a top-down transformation feel safe to bet on. You hold that relationship from the first pre-sales conversation through the life of the account.

The work compounds in a way most roles don't. Every flagship deployment you lead feeds directly into our playbooks and raises the quality of every build that follows. Hard-won lessons on your accounts become leverage across the whole company, and the IP you create outlives any single agent.

These are the largest, most complex enterprises in the market. The ones that require deep customization, real judgment, and a partner who can operate at the highest level. This is not a standardized implementation role, and it is not an account management or customer success role.

 

About the Role

This role owns the successful delivery, adoption, and expansion of AI solutions for Decagon's customers, serving as the primary technical and strategic owner. You earn trust with the customer's leadership team, scope a solution that solves their problems, and then build the working AI agent. You are the direct owner for each account's agents end-to-end, partnering with our Strategic Account Directors, Agent Strategy Managers and Forward Deployed Engineers to scale the agent in production and grow it into a core part of how the customer's company runs.

It is a rare combination: the executive influence of a top strategy consulting leader, the instincts of a product builder, and the ownership of a founder. If you have ever wanted to build the solution instead of hand off the recommendation, this role was designed for you. You own the outcome end to end, on the highest-stakes accounts in the market, with all of Decagon's cross-functional teams behind you.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You are trusted to make high-stakes decisions independently and own outcomes, gaining leverage by directing forward deployed engineers and partner teams who own a share of the execution.

 

In this role, you will

  • Own the technical win on Decagon's largest strategic opportunities, partnering with Sales, Solutions Engineers and Forward-deployed engineers to build working AI agents that turn sophisticated, skeptical buyers into signed customers.

  • Serve as the executive partner to the C-suite of Fortune 500 companies, defining and driving their AI transformation roadmap and owning the relationship from first conversation through production and expansion.

  • Design, build, and optimize enterprise-grade AI agents in production, going deep on each customer's workflows, pain points, and goals.

  • Turn the frameworks and playbooks you develop into reusable assets that scale across accounts and feed directly into Decagon's product roadmap.

  • Direct Forward-deployed engineers and partner teams to deliver at scale while you stay accountable for the outcome.

  • Run tight feedback loops into Product and Engineering, shaping the product based on what you learn on the front lines of our most demanding deployments.

     

Your background looks something like this

  • 6+ years of experience owning ambiguous, high-stakes outcomes and earning the trust of senior executives. This includes engagement managers, project leaders, and senior managers from top consulting firms, as well as product managers, founders, and forward-deployed or solutions roles at high-growth technology companies.

  • A builder's instinct. You want to design and build the actual solution, not just diagnose the problem or manage someone else who builds it.

  • Strong technical acumen. You can understand and shape AI agent designs and hold your own in a technical conversation with both engineers and executives.

  • Executive presence and a track record of becoming a trusted advisor to senior decision-makers at large, complex organizations.

  • Comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where you shape the solution as much as you implement it.

     

Even better

  • A Computer Science, Engineering, or Math degree, or equivalent hands-on technical experience.

  • An MBA, or equivalent experience at the intersection of business strategy and technology, is a plus.

  • Experience selling, deploying, or advising on enterprise software or transformation programs at the Fortune 500 level.

Compensation

£145k – £180K + Offers Equity

Benefits

We proudly offer the following benefits for our full-time employees:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life Insurance and Disability Benefits

  • Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension)

  • Parental Leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work-life balance

  • Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best

  • Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave)

These benefits are described in more detail in Decagon’s policies, may vary by location, and can change at any time according to applicable compensation and benefits plans.

title: Sr. Creative Designer (Performance Marketing) - Static & Motion
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Kraken
description_html:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

 

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

Kraken's Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, static and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

 

The opportunity

As our Senior Performance Creative, you concept, produce and ship paid creative for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Paid static is the center of the role, but we're hiring a hybrid rather than a specialist: this means you also ideate and create performance video and treat gen AI as a core production method rather than a novelty. You take a project from idea to a finished, approved, multi-market asset set, and you bring a real feel for what people stop on, share and screenshot.

 

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Senior here means craft and automation leadership: you set the bar for paid static on the team, work with AI enabled processes, collaborate closely with other Krakenites in and outside the team, and are the person others come to with performance creative questions.

  • Own paid static for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.

  • Build for channels like Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit and X. You know what wins where, and you build to each platform's specs and native feel.

  • Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets, from 9:16 sound-on to static-adjacent 1:1 and 4:5.

  • Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video and imagery, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn't.

  • Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using.

  • Version and localize at scale across markets, languages, formats and regulatory requirements. In a typical month you'll have roughly a dozen workstreams in flight at once, most spanning several formats and several markets.

  • Build creative that's designed to be tested. Performance Marketing owns test design, cadence and readouts. You own the creative response: reading the results, forming a point of view on why a variant won, and turning that into the next round of hooks, concepts and cuts.

  • Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea.

  • Hold a high craft bar on your own work and keep your files clean enough for other people to build on.

     

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years in performance creative at a high-volume in-house team or performance agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

  • A portfolio that proves it, submitted with your application. Paid static above all, with the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you're able to share it. Include two or three full video cuts, at least one AI-generated or AI-assisted piece with a short note on what was tooling and what was you, and one concept you tested where you can talk us through what the data said and what you changed.

  • Layout, hierarchy, type and composition that hold up at thumbnail size, in feed, and in multiple languages.

  • Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.

  • Real video skills, from concept to finished, sound-designed cut.

  • High-level command of gen AI video and image tooling, with shipped work to show for it.

  • Experience inside a structured creative testing program. You're fluent in the metrics your creative moves (thumb-stop rate, hook rate, CTR, CVR, CPA and ROAS), you can tell a real winner from low performers, and can translate test results into a creative decision.

  • Fluency in internet and meme culture, with comedic timing and an instinct for what's about to feel dated.

  • Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.

  • Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with layouts that survive risk warnings and market-specific requirements.

  • A solid copywriting instinct. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.

  • Figma and Adobe CC (After Effects, Premiere, Photoshop) as well as strong genAI skills

  • Curious about investing and crypto at a minimum, and able to make the space legible to others.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

What you bring

  • Confident communicator, able to influence senior stakeholders and represent the firm in external engagements

  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and resilient — with the ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and manage competing priorities

 
 

Nice to haves

description_html:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.


We're looking for a Head of Exchange Infrastructure to own the layer every Kraken product is built on: the matching engine, core infrastructure, third-party custody, the algo engine and the API engine. Kraken grew up as a set of vertically integrated products, each with its own engine and its own APIs. This role consolidates them into a single exchange stack that serves every product and every interface. You will lead a team of four to five product managers, partnered with an engineering manager. It is a senior, independent team, which means you get leverage quickly and you are expected to stay close to the work.

 

The opportunity

  • Own the product vision and roadmap for the exchange layer: matching engine, core infrastructure, third-party custody, algo engine and API engine

  • Lead and grow a team of four to five product managers, and set the bar for product craft across the layer

  • Lead the consolidation of multiple matching engines into one, starting with US derivatives, then international derivatives, then spot

  • Build interface-agnostic, so every product team and every interface can build on the same platform rather than their own

  • Define success metrics (p99 latency, throughput, uptime, resiliency) and hold teams accountable to them

  • Partner with engineering leaders across exchange and core infrastructure to sequence the migration without disrupting live markets

  • Partner with Risk and Credit Infrastructure so a client can hold one account and trade every product against it

  • Anticipate industry shifts and shape our platform to stay ahead

  • Align cross-functional teams (product, engineering, risk, compliance) around the exchange strategy

 

What you bring

  • Senior product leader with experience in exchange, trading, or high-performance platforms

  • Experience managing and developing product managers, on a team senior enough to run without you in the room

  • Happy to be a player-coach. This team is independent, so you will own roadmaps and write specs yourself at times, not only review them

  • Proven ability to set product vision and translate it into a long-term roadmap

  • Strong understanding of matching engine and market data architecture, and the tradeoffs low latency forces

  • Experience building platforms for internal customers, with the judgment to tell a platform from a series of bespoke builds

  • Excellent communication skills — can influence technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • A passion for crypto markets, market structure, and building the next generation of infrastructure

 

Nice to haves

  • Engineering background before moving into product, so you've built or operated high-performance systems yourself and not just specced them

  • Experience across both spot and derivatives venues, with the market structure differences that come with each

  • Time at a crypto exchange operating at comparable scale, volume and uptime expectations

  • Track record building platform roadmaps that interlock with adjacent product orgs rather than running in isolation

description_html:
About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates.

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation.

Your Role

Are you passionate about hospitality and eager to make a real difference for hoteliers? At RoomPriceGenie, we're on a mission to help hotels boost revenue and simplify their operations. Our young, dynamic team is spread across Europe, with offices in Mannheim, Germany, and Steinhausen, Switzerland—and we're looking for an energetic Sales Development Representative to join us in driving growth and innovation!

In this role, you'll be the first point of contact for potential clients, sparking interest in RoomPriceGenie and connecting qualified property owners with our Sales Managers for product demos. You’ll play a key role in expanding our reach and will have the opportunity to contribute to our fast-growing startup’s success.

What You'll Do:

  • Engage with prospects: Identify decision-makers, uncover key business challenges, and pitch RoomPriceGenie’s solutions to ignite interest.

  • Daily outreach: Make and track phone calls through Hubspot, connecting with new prospects and keeping track of your success.

  • Bring your insights: Use your local market knowledge to enhance our outbound marketing activities and connect with hotel owners in a meaningful way.

  • Stay ahead of industry trends: Keep up-to-date on the latest hospitality industry news, trends, and competitor offerings to add value in your conversations.

  • Collaborate with management: Help streamline and optimize the customer journey, bringing fresh ideas to make processes smoother and more efficient.

  • Shape the future: Influence how our young startup develops by trying out your own approaches and contributing innovative ideas.

Your Profile

  • Native English speaker with excellent communication skills.

  • Currently based in United Kingdom or in CET timezone.

  • Sales-driven with a natural aptitude for understanding customer needs.

  • Tech-savvy and excited by the latest technology trends.

  • Positive and outgoing: You’re empathetic, enthusiastic, and love connecting with people.

  • Active listener: You know how to uncover pain points and find meaningful ways to engage with prospects.

  • Organized and detail-oriented: You thrive in a fast-paced environment and can juggle multiple tasks with ease.

  • Team player: Success is sweeter when it’s achieved together, and you love contributing to team goals.

Nice to have

  • Additional European languages (Italian, French, or more!).

  • Experience in a SaaS or travel-tech company.

  • Hospitality industry experience or a passion for helping hotels.

  • Ability to work from our offices on a regular basis.

What We Offer at RoomPriceGenie 💪

At RoomPriceGenie, we don’t just offer jobs; we offer an adventure! 🚀 Join us in an exciting startup atmosphere where you can grow your career while changing the world for tens of thousands of independent hoteliers. 🌍 Our global and diverse team is fueled by passion and a shared mission. We thrive in a culture that’s all about transparency, respect, and making a real impact together.

Here’s what you can expect when you become part of our Genie family:

  • Remote-First Model: Work from (almost!) anywhere. 🌍🧑‍💻 Some roles need you in a specific country or time zone — we'll always flag that in the job ad. And whenever you like, come co-work with us in Mannheim, Berlin, or Sydney. 🏢

  • One Team, One Vision, One Goal: We’re in this together! 🤝 Our Genies are laser-focused on our mission, collaborating to make magic happen. ✨ It’s no wonder we score a stellar 9.3 from our team members! 🌟

  • Epic Team Gatherings: Every year, we bring our global crew together 🌎 for a week of networking, brainstorming, and fun. 🎉 Plus, enjoy regular hangouts in our offices to keep the camaraderie alive.

  • Growth and Development: We’re all about lifelong learning! 📚 Level up your skills with personal and professional development opportunities. You’ll even snag up to three extra days off each year to focus on your growth. 📈

  • 5 Years? 5 Weeks! Stick with us, and we’ll reward your loyalty. After five years, you’ll earn an incredible five weeks of bonus vacation time 🏖️ to recharge and explore the world. 🌍

  • Birthday Celebrations: It’s your day, so take it off! 🎂 Celebrate your birthday the way you want, guilt-free.

  • Flexible Hours: We get it—life happens! ⏰ We offer flexible working hours to help you balance your work and personal life seamlessly.

  • Wellbeing Matters: Your mental health is a top priority. 🧘 Every Genie gets access to Headspace, the leading meditation app, to help you cultivate a happier, healthier, and more zen life. 🌿

  • BetterHelp Support: We also offer BetterHelp, a professional online therapy and counseling platform, giving you additional support whenever you need it.💛🧠

We kindly ask that recruitment agencies refrain from reaching out regarding this vacancy. Thank you for your understanding.

Compensation: £34K – £36K • Offers Commission

Up to £80,000 DOE plus Welcome Bonus up to £5,000 and Relocation Allowance up to £5,000
 
 
At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.
 
 
Peacehaven is our purpose-built small animal, first opinion branch based in the vibrant seaside town of Brighton & Hove that delivers advanced general practice services to clients on the coast, but clients also benefit from the skill sets and facilities available at the Brighton hospital if required. With its exciting and diverse culture, beautiful beach and seafront and excellent transport links to central London and Gatwick airport, Brighton and the surrounding area is a fantastic place to live. 
 
 
We are looking for an enthusiastic candidate with some years of experience who enjoys working sole charge, running a branch under the guidance and leadership of the Director of Clinical Services. Our objective is always to maintain a happy and supportive work environment and ensure our patients receive excellent clinical care. 
 
 

How You’ll Make a Difference

 
 
As a Senior Veterinary Surgeon, you’ll work collaboratively with the wider team to deliver a high standard of patient and client care across a varied and rewarding caseload.
 
You’ll continue to develop your clinical skills and interests while sharing your knowledge and experience with colleagues, contributing positively to the clinical culture of the practice. You’ll be an integral member of the clinical team, delivering excellent care and supporting the ongoing development of those around you.
 

Working Pattern

 
* 40 hours per week 
* Shifts are issued 12 weeks in advance and typically run between 8:00am and 7:00pm
* No out-of-hours commitment
 
 

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

 
 
You are a confident and motivated Veterinary Surgeon who enjoys working as part of a team and is committed to delivering high-quality patient and client care. You’ll bring:
 
 
* A Veterinary degree and registration (or eligibility to register) with the RCVS
* Experience working in clinical practice with growing confidence in routine medical and surgical cases
* Strong communication skills and the ability to build effective relationships with clients and colleagues
* A proactive approach to learning, with openness to feedback and development
* Professionalism, reliability and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively
 
 

How We’ll Support You

 
 
At inspiring vet care, we’re committed to supporting your ongoing development and wellbeing. When you join us, you’ll benefit from:
 
* Clear career pathways with progression opportunities across primary care, referral, leadership and specialist roles
* Funded learning and development, including CPD allowance and access to IVC Academy training centres and role-relevant courses
* £1,250 annual Care Fund for every vet
* Access to mentors, regional clinical coaches and peer networks
* Support to develop clinical interests and expand your capabilities
* A collaborative, values-led culture focused on care, community and continuous improvement
 
 

What We Offer Our Team

 
 
* 6.8 weeks’ holiday, including bank holidays
* Private medical insurance
* Enhanced family leave and pay across maternity, paternity, adoption and surrogacy
* BVA membership, VDS cover & RCVS fees
* Cycle to Work and Green Car schemes (eligibility applies)
* Retail discounts and cashback offers
* Reduced-cost veterinary care for your own pets
 
 
 
We’re committed to supporting our people through career development opportunities, wellbeing initiatives and access to world-class learning resources.
 
 
 
Whether you’re just starting out or looking to take the next step in your career, inspiring vet care offers the support, opportunity and community to help you grow.
